DECLARE @Environment  Varchar (4)
DECLARE @FileName      Varchar (255)
DECLARE @EmailName   Varchar (Max)

SET @Environment         =  CASE WHEN Right(@@SERVERNAME,1) = 'D' THEN 'DEV' WHEN Right(@@SERVERNAME,1)   = 'Q' THEN 'QA' WHEN Right(@@SERVERNAME,1)  = 'P' THEN 'PROD' END 
SET @FileName                =  'MCD_EPSDT_REGISTRY_ROSTER_' 
SET @EmailName	        = ?

SELECT 
 [MARKET]
 ,[FILE_PATH] = REPLACE ([FILE_PATH],'[ENV]',@Environment)
 ,FileName = 'MCD_EPSDT_REGISTRY_ROSTER_' + [MARKET]
 ,[EmailName] = @EmailName	
  FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[REGISTRY_MEMBERS_ROSTER_MKT_CONFIG]
WHERE  [ACTIVE] = 1
